verdicts.reason: A has a strong 3-line headline that leads the layout, a readable logo and a clear left-to-right flow. However, the right side is cramped: '25% off on June 21.' is squeezed against the CTA, the legal block is almost as large as the offer, the decorative circles are awkwardly cropped in the top-left corner and the sash bleeds off the left edge. B shrinks the logo until it is barely legible and reduces the headline to one line, so it loses hierarchy and leaves dead space between the headline and the bottom-heavy row of offer, CTA and legal text. B's legal text competes with the headline, and its sash and phone crowd the bottom edge.
